source: Measured, not published: the reference solution of this folder (solution/controller.py reads each episode's picture manual from the observation at t = 0 with read_manual.py, finds and localises every part and the stand with the wrist camera alone, and seats the axles and wheels by force-guided pressing on the wrist force/torque reading) in a real `ale validate` run on the pinned engine (bfb7505), host lab208, 2026-11-27, run validate-2a58a537 with a null value: 6 hidden-seed episodes, each a different car with its own manual, all 8 mates by kit parts and the car rolling in each, no part damaged, assembly_score = 1.0, probe lock 96/96. Later runs of the same folder are listed in the pull request.
reference_commit: task folder not yet committed; repository main at abb2c8e8 (2026-11-26)
note: full_at 0.85 from the measured spread: the reference measured assembly_score 1.0 in the bootstrap validate (validate-2a58a537); four further oracle runs of this folder measured 0.867, 1.0, 1.0 and 1.0; in the dev harness, on 100 fresh seeds each with its own random car and press fits, it built 95 cars completely and rolling, a mean of 0.983. From that spread a six-episode mean falls below 0.9 about 1.4 % of the time and below 0.85 about 0.25 % of the time.
